title: Brjuno condition through best approximations and the linearization problem
summary: We consider the classical analytic linearization problem for vector fields on the torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ close to a constant vector field $ω$. Our goals are twofold. First, we provide a geometric framework in which the arithmetic condition governing analytic linearization arises naturally from the orbit of a unimodular lattice associated with $ω$ under a diagonal flow on $\operatorname{SL}(d,\mathbb{Z})\backslash \operatorname{SL}(d,\mathbb{R})$.
